datasets.name: Vaccination Coverage among Adults 18+ Years (BRFSS)
datasets.description: Annual vaccination coverage for flu, pneumococcal, shingles, Tdap, HPV, and hepatitis among adults 18+ by state, age, race/ethnicity, and insurance status from BRFSS (2008–present)

datasets.name: Acute Respiratory Illness (ARI) Activity Level by State
datasets.description: Weekly state-level ARI activity indicator labels (Minimal/Low/Moderate/High/Very High) derived from NSSP emergency department data — the modern equivalent of the FluView ILI activity map

datasets.name: BEAM Dashboard – Report Data
datasets.description: CDC BEAM (Bacteria, Enterics, Ameba, and Mycotics) isolate reports by state, month, source type (Human/Animal/Food), source site, pathogen, and serotype. Covers Campylobacter, Salmonella, Shigella, STEC, and Vibrio. Use fetch_beam.py for the pre-aggregated national monthly CSV.

datasets.name: Quarterly Birth Indicators
datasets.description: Provisional quarterly birth rates, teen births, preterm births, cesarean rates by race/ethnicity

datasets.name: Vaccination Coverage: Young Children (0–35 months)
datasets.description: National Immunization Survey (NIS-Child) vaccination coverage for DTaP, MMR, polio, Hib, PCV, rotavirus, Hep A/B, varicella, and influenza — by state, race/ethnicity, insurance status, and birth cohort

datasets.name: U.S. Chronic Disease Indicators (CDI)
datasets.description: State-level indicators across 19 chronic disease topics: alcohol, arthritis, asthma, cancer, cardiovascular disease, COPD, diabetes, mental health, tobacco, and more. Includes prevalence, mortality, and risk factor measures by state and demographics.

datasets.name: COVID-19 Cases & Deaths
datasets.description: COVID-19 weekly cases and deaths by state

datasets.name: COVID-19 Contributing Conditions
datasets.description: COVID-19 deaths by contributing condition, age group, and state

datasets.name: NIS-ACM: Adult COVID-19 Vaccination Coverage and Attitudes
datasets.description: Monthly COVID-19 vaccination coverage and vaccine confidence among adults by state and demographic group from the National Immunization Survey Adult COVID Module (NIS-ACM)

datasets.name: Weekly COVID-19 Hospitalization Metrics by Jurisdiction (Archived)
datasets.description: Archived weekly COVID-19 hospital admissions, inpatient bed utilization, and staff ICU bed occupancy by state and national (USA) — data through May 2024 when mandatory reporting ended

datasets.name: COVID-NET: COVID-19 Hospitalizations
datasets.description: Lab-confirmed COVID-19 hospitalization rates from COVID-NET surveillance, by state/age/sex/race. Long/tidy format: value pivoted across data_type ('Weekly Rate'/'Cumulative Rate', plus clinical breakdowns) x estimate_type x rate_type, in a single `estimate` column.

datasets.name: Preliminary Estimates of Cumulative COVID-19 Hospitalizations by Week
datasets.description: Weekly preliminary estimates of cumulative US COVID-19 hospitalizations since start of each respiratory season, with 95% uncertainty intervals

datasets.name: Preliminary Estimates of Cumulative RSV Hospitalizations by Week
datasets.description: Weekly preliminary estimates of cumulative US RSV hospitalizations since start of each respiratory season, with 95% uncertainty intervals

datasets.name: Historical Death Rates by Cause
datasets.description: Age-adjusted death rates for major causes (heart disease, cancer, stroke, etc.) since 1900

datasets.name: Disability Prevalence
datasets.description: Disability status and types by state: mobility, cognitive, hearing, vision, self-care (BRFSS)

datasets.name: VSRR Provisional County-Level Drug Overdose Deaths
datasets.description: Quarterly provisional drug overdose death counts at county level from NVSS, with 12-month rolling periods

datasets.name: Drug Poisoning Mortality by State
datasets.description: Drug poisoning/overdose death rates by state, sex, race, and age

datasets.name: VSRR Provisional Drug Overdose Deaths
datasets.description: Monthly provisional drug overdose death counts by state and drug type from NVSS, with 12-month rolling totals (2015–present)

datasets.name: CDC Epidemic Trends and Rt
datasets.description: Weekly estimated effective reproduction number (Rt), trend category, and probability of epidemic growth for COVID-19, influenza, and RSV by state

datasets.name: Influenza Vaccination Coverage, All Ages 6+ Months (NIS-Flu)
datasets.description: Monthly cumulative influenza vaccination coverage by state, age group, race/ethnicity, and poverty level from NIS-Flu (2009–present)

datasets.name: Weekly Cumulative Flu Vaccine Doses Distributed
datasets.description: Weekly cumulative influenza vaccine doses distributed nationally by flu season

datasets.name: HAICViz: Antimicrobial Resistance (CRAB, CRE, ESBL)
datasets.description: Annual case rates for carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (CRAB), carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales (CRE), and ESBL-producing organisms from the CDC MuGSI/EIP network. Breakdowns by age, organism, and exposure.

datasets.name: HAICViz: Candidemia (Invasive Candida)
datasets.description: Annual drug resistance rates and case metrics for Candida bloodstream infections from CDC surveillance. Species-level breakdown and antifungal resistance trends.

datasets.name: HAICViz: Clostridioides difficile (C. diff)
datasets.description: Annual case rates for Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) from the CDC Emerging Infections Program (EIP) network. Breakdowns by age, community vs. healthcare onset, and case severity.

datasets.name: HAICViz: Invasive Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA/MSSA)
datasets.description: Annual case rates for invasive Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA and MSSA) from the CDC Emerging Infections Program (EIP) network. Breakdowns by age, sex, race, dialysis status, and exposure type.

datasets.name: Vaccination Coverage among Health Care Personnel
datasets.description: Annual influenza vaccination coverage among health care personnel by state, personnel type, and setting from the National Healthcare Safety Network (2013–2021)

datasets.name: Leading Causes of Death
datasets.description: U.S. leading causes of death by state and year

datasets.name: Life Expectancy
datasets.description: Life expectancy at birth by race (All Races, Black, White) and sex

datasets.name: Monthly Provisional Counts of Deaths by Select Causes
datasets.description: Monthly provisional US death counts for 20+ causes: cancer (malignant neoplasms), heart disease, diabetes, Alzheimer's, influenza/pneumonia, CLRD, stroke, drug overdose, suicide, COVID-19, and more. National and state-level.

datasets.name: Provisional Mortality Rates
datasets.description: Quarterly age-adjusted death rates by cause, sex, and state

datasets.name: NHANES Measured Obesity, Hypertension & Cholesterol
datasets.description: Prevalence of obesity, hypertension, and high total cholesterol among adults 20+, national, by sex and age group, 1999-2000 through 2017-2018. Derived from NHANES physical exams — measured height/weight/blood pressure/labs, not self-report. Obesity here runs consistently ~7-10 points above the self-reported BRFSS figures in `nutrition_obesity`, which is the expected direction and size of self-report bias.

datasets.name: Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data (NHSN)
datasets.description: Weekly hospital-reported COVID-19, influenza, and RSV new admissions, current inpatient/ICU patients, and bed occupancy by state/territory and nationally (jurisdiction='USA'), from NHSN (2020–present)

datasets.name: NNDSS Weekly Measles Cases
datasets.description: Weekly provisional measles case counts (imported and indigenous) by state/territory, with cumulative annual totals, from NNDSS

datasets.name: NNDSS Table 1G: Chlamydia & Carbapenemase-Producing Organisms
datasets.description: Weekly provisional case counts for chlamydia trachomatis, chancroid, and carbapenemase-producing organisms by state/territory from NNDSS

datasets.name: NNDSS Table 1M: Gonorrhea
datasets.description: Weekly provisional gonorrhea case counts by state/territory from NNDSS (current week, 52-week max, cumulative)

datasets.name: NNDSS Table 1HH: Syphilis
datasets.description: Weekly provisional syphilis case counts (primary & secondary, congenital) by state/territory from NNDSS

datasets.name: NNDSS Weekly Notifiable Diseases
datasets.description: Provisional weekly case counts for ~100 nationally notifiable diseases (measles, pertussis, hepatitis, TB, Lyme, etc.) by state

datasets.name: NREVSS RSV Laboratory Data (Historical)
datasets.description: Weekly RSV antigen and PCR test counts and positivity from NREVSS participating labs by HHS region (historical; for 2020–present use rsv_positivity instead)

datasets.name: NSSP Emergency Department Visit Trajectories
datasets.description: Weekly % of ED visits for COVID-19, influenza, and RSV by state and county from NSSP sentinel emergency departments, with trend direction (increasing/stable/decreasing)

datasets.name: Nursing Home Respiratory Pathogens & Vaccination (NHSN)
datasets.description: Weekly COVID-19, Influenza, and RSV case counts, hospitalizations, and vaccination rates for nursing home residents by state, from NHSN

datasets.name: Vaccination Coverage among Nursing Home Residents
datasets.description: Annual influenza and pneumococcal vaccination coverage among nursing home residents by state, age group, and HHS region from the Long-Term Care Minimum Data Set (2005–2021)

datasets.name: Nutrition, Physical Activity & Obesity
datasets.description: Adult obesity, physical inactivity, and fruit/vegetable consumption by state from BRFSS (self-reported height/weight)

datasets.name: NVSN Viral Pathogen Positivity in Children (ARI)
datasets.description: Weekly % positivity for 9 viral pathogens (influenza A/B, RSV, SARS-CoV-2, rhinovirus, etc.) among children enrolled in the New Vaccine Surveillance Network with acute respiratory illness, by age group (2017–present)

datasets.name: PLACES: City Health
datasets.description: City-level health indicators: obesity, diabetes, smoking, depression, and 30+ more (BRFSS-based)

datasets.name: PLACES: County Health
datasets.description: County-level chronic disease indicators (BRFSS-based): obesity, diabetes, high blood pressure, heart disease, stroke, cancer, COPD, arthritis. Archive is filtered to these measures; the full 39-measure dataset (also including smoking, depression, sleep, etc.) is queryable live via `cdc_open query swc5-untb` or `get_places_county_health()`.

datasets.name: Vaccination Coverage among Pregnant Women
datasets.description: Annual flu and Tdap vaccination coverage among pregnant women by state, race/ethnicity, and insurance status (2012–present)

datasets.name: NIS-FRVM: Fall Respiratory Virus Vaccination Coverage, Adults
datasets.description: Monthly COVID-19, influenza, and RSV vaccination coverage among adults and older adults from the National Immunization Survey Fall Respiratory Virus Module (NIS-FRVM), by state and demographics (2024–present)

datasets.name: Provisional % Deaths: COVID-19, Flu & RSV
datasets.description: Provisional weekly percentage of total US deaths attributed to COVID-19, Influenza, and RSV

datasets.name: Provisional % Deaths: COVID-19, Flu & RSV by Demographics
datasets.description: Provisional weekly percentage of deaths for COVID-19, Influenza, and RSV stratified by age, sex, race/ethnicity, and state

datasets.name: Respiratory Conditions Treated in the Emergency Department
datasets.description: Weekly % of ED visits for specific respiratory conditions (influenza, RSV, COVID-19, pneumonia, bronchiolitis, etc.) by age group, from NSSP — equivalent to ILI surveillance

datasets.name: RESP-LENS: Respiratory Virus Lab Positivity (ED Network)
datasets.description: Weekly % positivity for 9 respiratory viruses (influenza A/B, RSV, SARS-CoV-2, etc.) among ED patients by HHS region and age group — the closest Socrata equivalent to NREVSS flu lab data (2021–2024)

datasets.name: RESP-NET: RSV, COVID-19 & Flu Hospitalizations
datasets.description: Weekly lab-confirmed hospitalization rates for RSV, COVID-19, and Influenza from RESP-NET population-based surveillance, by age/sex/race

datasets.name: Weekly Respiratory Virus Vaccination Coverage
datasets.description: Weekly flu, COVID-19, and RSV vaccination coverage for children and adults from National Immunization Survey, by state/demographics

datasets.name: RSV Vaccination Coverage, Adults 60+, by Jurisdiction (Weekly)
datasets.description: Weekly cumulative RSV vaccination coverage among adults 60 years and older by state and nationally, from NIS-ACM (2023–present)

datasets.name: RSV-NET: RSV Hospitalizations
datasets.description: Lab-confirmed RSV hospitalization rates in children and adults from RSV-NET surveillance, by state/age/sex/race. Long/tidy format: value pivoted across data_type ('Weekly Rate'/'Cumulative Rate', plus clinical breakdowns like 'Diabetes'/'Severe Obesity (BMI ≥40)') x estimate_type x rate_type, in a single `estimate` column.

datasets.name: RSV Test Positivity (NREVSS)
datasets.description: Weekly RSV NAAT test positivity rates and detection counts by national and HHS region, from NREVSS participating labs

datasets.name: SchoolVaxView: Kindergarten Vaccination Coverage & Exemptions
datasets.description: Annual vaccination coverage and exemption estimates for kindergartners from the CDC School Vaccination Assessment Program, by state and nationally. Covers DTaP, MMR, polio, hepatitis B, varicella, and exemption rates. Complements NIS-Child (ages 19–35 months) by capturing coverage at school entry (~age 5).

datasets.name: CDC Wastewater Viral Activity Level (SARS-CoV-2, Flu A, RSV)
datasets.description: Weekly wastewater viral activity level (WVAL) scores and categories (Very Low/Low/Moderate/High/Very High) per sampling site for SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A, and RSV

datasets.name: NWSS Wastewater: SARS-CoV-2
datasets.description: SARS-CoV-2 RNA concentrations from US wastewater sampling sites via NWSS, updated weekly

datasets.name: NWSS Wastewater: Influenza A
datasets.description: Influenza A RNA concentrations from US wastewater sampling sites via NWSS, updated weekly

datasets.name: CDC Wastewater Data for Avian Influenza A (H5)
datasets.description: Raw wastewater sample measurements for Avian Influenza A (H5) at US sampling sites — concentration, flow-normalized values, and detection flags

datasets.name: NWSS Wastewater: Measles
datasets.description: Measles RNA concentrations from US wastewater sampling sites via NWSS, updated weekly

datasets.name: NWSS Wastewater: RSV
datasets.description: RSV RNA concentrations from US wastewater sampling sites via NWSS, updated weekly

datasets.name: Weekly Death Surveillance
datasets.description: Provisional weekly death counts by state: COVID-19, pneumonia, influenza, total deaths (updated weekly)

datasets.name: Weekly Deaths by Cause
datasets.description: Weekly deaths by state and cause: heart disease, cancer, diabetes, stroke, COVID, respiratory
